purpose: Public seed tasks for framework generation and evaluation. Keep separate held-out tasks for measuring model generalization.

tasks.prompt: Build a keyboard and touch controlled pixel collection game with a 320x180 logical viewport, atlas animation, solid tiles, a jump, restart, five collectibles, and a persistent best score. Play locally without a host.
acceptance: Movement and jump change game state
Touch release never leaves an action stuck

tasks.prompt: Build a vector character with a parented bone hierarchy, a looping greeting animation, and two interchangeable outfits. Switching the outfit must preserve the current pose. Add a pause control.
acceptance: The pose is unchanged while paused

tasks.prompt: Port a standard three.js scene with a perspective camera, physically based material, lighting, and OrbitControls to Paean imports without changing renderer behavior.
acceptance: All imports resolve from one upstream revision
Paean and three constructor identities match

tasks.prompt: Add optional Paean cloud progress to a game. Preserve local play, never prompt at boot or in feed preview, gate paid access on a play tap, and merge cloud best score before writing.
acceptance: Failed reads never write cloud state
Local edits during sync are preserved
No credentials or fake production bridge
